title: Ecosystem guide · Featheral Foundation
description: A guide to every Featheral site, the shared wallet, FTHG and native currencies, Gold and Notes APIs, trading, websites and the current writer/replica network.
body:
Ecosystem guide

What each site does, where balances live and how to use them safely.

All sitesOpen wallet

Every site, one purpose at a time

SiteWhat to use it for
FoundationDirectory, architecture and operating principles.
GoldEthereum FTHG, reserve status and Ethereum-related API reads.
DollarNative FTH$ information, wallet access and the public ledger explorer.
WorldGameplay, resources, settlements, social features and public profile setup.
ExchangeReal ledger swaps, trading accounts, charts, liquidity and settlement recovery.
NotesCommunity currencies, circulation, markets and native FTH currency APIs.
SitesCommunity website directory, website-and-note creation and owner editing tools.
StatsAggregate traffic and reports where public statistics are enabled.
WalletOne shared interface for holdings, transfers, tips, receiving and activity.
Admin · admin.featheral.comProtected CMS, operational controls and reviewed deployment for authorized administrators.

Use the shared wallet

Every site's wallet opens the same compact panel, styled to its host. The tabs are Assets, Send, Receive, Swap, Activity and Account. Icon buttons show hover/focus tooltips; arrow keys and Home/End navigate tabs. Detailed estimates and account tools are expandable instead of filling the balance view.

  1. Open Wallet from any site to view the central public account and linked holdings.
  2. Open the full wallet to connect an external Ethereum-compatible wallet, or create/unlock an encrypted built-in wallet under Account.
  3. Keep the downloaded encrypted backup and password separately. Losing both access and recovery material can permanently lose access to funds.
  4. Review the token, recipient, amount and network before approving any transfer or signature.

Public views follow account changes and refresh periodically; there is no manual public-wallet sync button. Hidden views defer refreshes. Browsers that isolate embedded storage may require the full wallet. Embeds never unlock keys or receive sign-in sessions.

Receive FTHG on Ethereum Mainnet only. FTH$ and community notes are not Ethereum tokens. Native ETH balances are tracked on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One, Optimism, zkSync Era and Linea; other L2 tokens are not tracked.

Totals are estimates, not spendable combined balances. Linked accounts, World gameplay funds and Exchange trading holdings stay separate. Missing prices and unavailable RPC data are disclosed, not replaced with zero or invented prices.

Know the currencies

FTHG · Featheral Gold
A fixed-supply ERC-20 token on Ethereum Mainnet. Its supply does not make it a claim on physical gold or guarantee a market price. Ethereum transfers require gas and explicit wallet authorization.
FTH$ · Featheral Dollar
A native Featheral ledger currency, not a US-dollar peg or redemption claim. Wallet transfers are signed; gameplay and exchanges conserve authorized existing supply. New bridge credits and staking-reward issuance are closed.
FTHX · Featheral Exchange Token
A native whole-unit ledger currency used for trading, voluntary Thanks and ecosystem fees. Trading funds must be withdrawn to the main wallet before sending or tipping.
Community notes
Independent native currencies associated with community websites. Native system currencies are not regular reward currencies; funding and reward settings remain separately controlled.

Trade and move funds deliberately

Swap links open Exchange. It uses actual global FTHX pools, executed trades and ledger balances, not simulated liquidity or demo deposits. Unfunded markets have no executable price.

  1. Deposit existing whole FTHX into your separate trading account.
  2. Review the quote and slippage before trading FTH$, FTHX or a funded community note.
  3. Withdraw acquired assets to the same owner's main wallet before sending or tipping.

Charts show executed candles, volume and history. Initial liquidity requires explicit authorization and existing balances; it is not automatically fabricated. World funds use their own deposit/withdraw workflow. Reserve obligations are not equivalent to confirmed Ethereum settlement.

Create a website and note

Sites and Notes offer combined creation of a new website and its note. The current creation fee is 1,000 FTHX + 500 existing FTH$. Note-only creation requests are not supported.

Websites live under sites.featheral.com/site-name/. Owners edit pages, theme, name and directory description; visitors search sites and linked notes. A failed provision after reservation can be resumed without paying the note fee again. Rewards start disabled, and no market pool is funded automatically.

API and network boundaries

OwnerResponsibility
Gold · /api/v1/gold/*Ethereum RPC reads, FTHG, supported native ETH balances, reserve evidence and signed reserve operations.
Notes · /api/v1/notes/*Native FTH$ ledger reads, signed transfers and profiles. Existing /api/v1/dollar/* URLs remain aliases to the same ledger.
Notes-backed application APIsNative note balances, wallet summaries, site payments and trading use shared authoritative ledgers. Ethereum information in summaries comes from Gold, not independent Note RPC access.
Protected AdminCMS edits, authorized funding and product operations stay behind administration access and operation-specific authorization.

The FTH$ ledger has a configured writer and validating read replicas. Replicas automatically retrieve and verify signed blocks or synchronized daily files. Native transfers do not submit Ethereum transactions.

This is an application-ledger network, not a deployed Layer 3 rollup. Rollup settlement contracts, decentralized consensus and a production L3 deployment are not claimed. A route or UI label does not provide those guarantees.

FTHG source/backing settlement remains the exception to automatic views: authorized administrators explicitly move Ethereum funds, then authorize reconciliation of a finalized canonical receipt. The signature is bound to the ledger, transaction, log and timestamp. Previewing a plan does not send Ethereum funds.

Read before approving

No guaranteed returns, automatic rewards, leverage or simulated order book are implied. FTH$ is not redeemable for US dollars, and portfolio estimates are not swap quotes. See operating principles for authorization, publication and privacy boundaries.

Work together in Featheral App

Featheral App is the mobile-first Foundation intranet for volunteers, interns and managers. Create a World profile, request access, then wait for administrator approval. Membership, divisions, teams, roles and progression levels are assigned through protected Admin user management.

Foundation, division, team and direct conversations keep work private. Chat, private files, shared notes, one-to-one calls and screen sharing support delivery. Missions progress from ready to in progress, evidence-backed review and manager approval. Browser push is opt-in and requires operator configuration; private content is not cached for offline use. Existing World gameplay conversations and personal messages stay in World.

Featheral Silver (FTHS), also known as Featheral Salary, is a native whole-unit note. Completing work does not automatically mint salary. Administrators explicitly approve each grant; grants and membership changes are auditable. Silver has no guaranteed wage, USD peg, return or market price. Notes lists Silver; Exchange can execute FTHS/FTHX trades only after an administrator funds real liquidity. No FTHX is automatically minted or moved.
